title: Reducing Unintended Identity Bias in Russian Hate Speech Detection

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating text classification models by calculating the Generalized Mean of Bias AUCs (GMB-AUC) on a dataset of Russian social media comments using a compiled list of protected identity terms related to physical appearance.
